review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, rolling pass 2026-10-04: items 643-655 (home-folder pruning and cache manager, update channel and What's new, proxy, portable mode, session reopen and crash-draft restore, read-only project windows, undo/redo, job progress, accessibility), written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: A PEM file of certificates to trust, for networks that inspect HTTPS with their own certificate authority. Empty uses the REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE or SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable when it is set. Default empty.
records.source: A PEM file of certificates to trust, for networks that inspect HTTPS with their own certificate authority. Empty uses the REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE or SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable when it is set. Default empty.
records.translation: Un archivo PEM de certificados de confianza, para redes que inspeccionan HTTPS con su propia autoridad de certificación. Si está vacío, se usa la variable de entorno REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE o SSL_CERT_FILE cuando está definida. Valor predeterminado vacío.

records.key: A run is in progress. Try again when it has finished.
records.source: A run is in progress. Try again when it has finished.
records.translation: Hay una ejecución en curso. Vuelva a intentarlo cuando haya terminado.

records.key: Another spaCR window (process {pid} on {host}) is using {path}.
records.source: Another spaCR window (process {pid} on {host}) is using {path}.
records.translation: Otra ventana de spaCR (proceso {pid} en {host}) está usando {path}.

records.key: Delete everything inside {folder}? The folder stays. Other programs that share this cache download their files again too.
records.source: Delete everything inside {folder}? The folder stays. Other programs that share this cache download their files again too.
records.translation: ¿Eliminar todo el contenido de {folder}? La carpeta se conserva. Los demás programas que comparten esta caché también volverán a descargar sus archivos.
Se eliminaron {count} elemento(s) y se liberaron {size}.

records.key: Empty the selected cache after asking. Models and environments are downloaded again when next needed. Default nothing cleared.
records.source: Empty the selected cache after asking. Models and environments are downloaded again when next needed. Default nothing cleared.
records.translation: Vacía la caché seleccionada tras pedir confirmación. Los modelos y entornos se vuelven a descargar la próxima vez que se necesiten. Valor predeterminado: no se vacía nada.

records.key: Every start reopens the module that was on screen when spaCR last closed or crashed, with its settings and folder. Open fresh in the status bar, or starting with --fresh, skips it once. Off always starts on Home. Default on.
records.source: Every start reopens the module that was on screen when spaCR last closed or crashed, with its settings and folder. Open fresh in the status bar, or starting with --fresh, skips it once. Off always starts on Home. Default on.
records.translation: Cada inicio vuelve a abrir el módulo que estaba en pantalla cuando spaCR se cerró o falló por última vez, con su configuración y su carpeta. Abrir de cero en la barra de estado, o iniciar con --fresh, lo omite una vez. Desactivado siempre inicia en Inicio. Valor predeterminado: activado.

records.key: Keep: nothing modified within this many days is deleted. Cap: older entries are deleted, oldest first, only while the folder is bigger than this; no cap deletes every older entry. Pruning runs only when you press Prune now.
records.source: Keep: nothing modified within this many days is deleted. Cap: older entries are deleted, oldest first, only while the folder is bigger than this; no cap deletes every older entry. Pruning runs only when you press Prune now.
records.translation: Conservar: no se elimina nada modificado en este número de días. Límite: las entradas más antiguas se eliminan, empezando por la más antigua, solo mientras la carpeta supere este tamaño; sin límite se eliminan todas las entradas más antiguas. La depuración solo se ejecuta al pulsar Depurar ahora.

records.key: List what the caps above would delete from the spaCR home folder, then ask before deleting it. Nothing is deleted automatically. Default off.
records.source: List what the caps above would delete from the spaCR home folder, then ask before deleting it. Nothing is deleted automatically. Default off.
records.translation: Enumera lo que los límites anteriores eliminarían de la carpeta principal de spaCR y pide confirmación antes de eliminarlo. No se elimina nada automáticamente. Valor predeterminado: desactivado.

records.key: Measure reads every cache's size, Clear empties the selected cache and Move puts it in another folder. Clear and Move ask first.
records.source: Measure reads every cache's size, Clear empties the selected cache and Move puts it in another folder. Clear and Move ask first.
records.translation: Measure lee el tamaño de cada caché, Vaciar vacía la caché seleccionada y Mover la coloca en otra carpeta. Vaciar y Mover piden confirmación antes.

records.key: Move the cache into this folder
records.source: Move the cache into this folder
records.translation: Mover la caché a esta carpeta

records.key: Move the selected cache to another folder or drive after asking; spaCR uses the new place from then on. Default the standard folder.
records.source: Move the selected cache to another folder or drive after asking; spaCR uses the new place from then on. Default the standard folder.
records.translation: Mueve la caché seleccionada a otra carpeta o unidad tras pedir confirmación; spaCR usa la nueva ubicación desde entonces. Valor predeterminado: la carpeta estándar.

records.key: Move {source} to {target}? spaCR uses the new folder from now on; a program already holding the old path picks it up after a restart.
records.source: Move {source} to {target}? spaCR uses the new folder from now on; a program already holding the old path picks it up after a restart.
records.translation: ¿Mover {source} a {target}? spaCR usará la nueva carpeta a partir de ahora; un programa que ya tenga abierta la ruta antigua tomará el cambio tras reiniciarse.

records.key: No release notes are available for this version.
records.source: No release notes are available for this version.
records.translation: No hay notas de la versión disponibles para esta versión.

records.key: Nothing is over its caps; nothing was deleted.
records.source: Nothing is over its caps; nothing was deleted.
records.translation: Nada supera sus límites; no se eliminó nada.

records.key: Portable mode: settings, caches, logs and runs are kept in {folder}.
records.source: Portable mode: settings, caches, logs and runs are kept in {folder}.
records.translation: Modo portátil: la configuración, las cachés, los registros y las ejecuciones se guardan en {folder}.

records.key: Proxy for every download: model weights, updates, plug-ins, pip and backend installers. Empty uses the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable when it is set. spacr-doctor reports whether the proxy reaches PyPI. Default empty.
records.source: Proxy for every download: model weights, updates, plug-ins, pip and backend installers. Empty uses the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable when it is set. spacr-doctor reports whether the proxy reaches PyPI. Default empty.
records.translation: Proxy para todas las descargas: pesos de modelos, actualizaciones, complementos, pip e instaladores de backends. Si está vacío, se usa la variable de entorno HTTPS_PROXY cuando está definida. spacr-doctor indica si el proxy llega a PyPI. Valor predeterminado vacío.

records.key: Put back this module's default settings and go to Home. Preferences can turn reopening off for good.
records.source: Put back this module's default settings and go to Home. Preferences can turn reopening off for good.
records.translation: Restablece la configuración predeterminada de este módulo y vuelve a Inicio. En Preferencias puede desactivar la reapertura de forma permanente.

records.key: Read the size of every cache. Default not measured.
records.source: Read the size of every cache. Default not measured.
records.translation: Lee el tamaño de cada caché. Valor predeterminado: sin medir.

records.key: Read-only: another spaCR window has this queue open.
records.source: Read-only: another spaCR window has this queue open.
records.translation: Solo lectura: otra ventana de spaCR tiene esta cola abierta.

records.key: Reopen the last module, settings and folder on start
records.source: Reopen the last module, settings and folder on start
records.translation: Reabrir al iniciar el último módulo, su configuración y su carpeta
Se reabrió {module} tal como lo dejó.

records.key: Show every running job with its progress and a Cancel button.
records.source: Show every running job with its progress and a Cancel button.
records.translation: Muestra cada trabajo en ejecución con su progreso y un botón Cancelar.

records.key: This window has {path} open read-only, so it will not run a pipeline that writes there. Close the other spaCR window, then run again.
records.source: This window has {path} open read-only, so it will not run a pipeline that writes there. Close the other spaCR window, then run again.
records.translation: Esta ventana tiene {path} abierto en solo lectura, por lo que no ejecutará una canalización que escriba allí. Cierre la otra ventana de spaCR y vuelva a ejecutar.

records.key: Two windows writing the same queue, measurements.db or results folder can corrupt them. Open it read-only to look without writing, or continue if you are sure the other window is idle.
records.source: Two windows writing the same queue, measurements.db or results folder can corrupt them. Open it read-only to look without writing, or continue if you are sure the other window is idle.
records.translation: Dos ventanas que escriben en la misma cola, measurements.db o carpeta de resultados pueden dañarlos. Ábralo en solo lectura para consultarlo sin escribir, o continúe si está seguro de que la otra ventana está inactiva.

records.key: Which versions Help → Check for updates offers. Stable offers only full releases. Nightly also offers pre-releases and development builds, which arrive sooner and are tested less. After an update spaCR shows what changed. Default stable.
records.source: Which versions Help → Check for updates offers. Stable offers only full releases. Nightly also offers pre-releases and development builds, which arrive sooner and are tested less. After an update spaCR shows what changed. Default stable.
records.translation: Qué versiones ofrece Ayuda → Buscar actualizaciones. Estable ofrece solo versiones completas. Nocturno ofrece además versiones preliminares y compilaciones de desarrollo, que llegan antes y se prueban menos. Tras una actualización, spaCR muestra qué ha cambiado. Valor predeterminado: estable.

records.key: spaCR did not close normally last time. Unsaved settings were kept for: {modules}. Restore them?
records.source: spaCR did not close normally last time. Unsaved settings were kept for: {modules}. Restore them?
records.translation: spaCR no se cerró correctamente la última vez. Se conservó la configuración no guardada de: {modules}. ¿Desea restaurarla?

records.key: spaCR keeps logs and a folder per run in its home folder. Pruning deletes the oldest of them once a folder is over its size cap, and never anything newer than the age you keep, the run in progress or a log that is open. You see the list before anything is deleted.
records.source: spaCR keeps logs and a folder per run in its home folder. Pruning deletes the oldest of them once a folder is over its size cap, and never anything newer than the age you keep, the run in progress or a log that is open. You see the list before anything is deleted.
records.translation: spaCR guarda registros y una carpeta por ejecución en su carpeta principal. La depuración elimina los más antiguos cuando una carpeta supera su límite de tamaño, y nunca nada más reciente que la antigüedad que usted conserva, la ejecución en curso ni un registro abierto. Verá la lista antes de que se elimine nada.

records.key: spaCR's model, Hugging Face, Torch, backend and news caches with their sizes. Press Measure to read the sizes.
records.source: spaCR's model, Hugging Face, Torch, backend and news caches with their sizes. Press Measure to read the sizes.
records.translation: Cachés de modelos, Hugging Face, Torch, backends y noticias de spaCR con sus tamaños. Pulse Measure para leer los tamaños.
